jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as an EHS Manager (f/m/d), where you will play a pivotal role in supporting and advising the GT Transformer business on essential environmental, health, and safety (EHS) requirements. Imagine driving initiatives that foster a culture of safe behavior and helping us climb the safety culture ladder. You will lead training initiatives within the EQS team, ensuring continuous improvement under our Zero Harm framework and integrated management systems, particularly focusing on ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards. Your analytical skills will shine as you track incident statistics and support root cause analyses, all while promoting regulatory compliance and closing any gaps.How You’ll Make an Impact * Drive initiatives to enhance a culture of safety within the organization* Lead and support necessary EHS training initiatives to promote awareness and compliance* Analyze EHS data and report incident statistics to identify trends and areas for improvement* Provide guidance on environmental, health, and safety issues, ensuring regulatory compliance* Facilitate regular meetings within the EQS community to promote information exchange and updates* Support root cause analysis of EHS events and track identified actions for continuous improvementWhat You Bring* A Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as engineering, industrial engineering, or environmental engineering* Several years of EHS experience in manufacturing or a related industry, ideally within Grid Technologies* Strong communication skills, akin to those of an influencer or salesperson, to effectively promote safety culture* Training as a specialist in occupational safety is a significant advantage* Experience in high-risk activities such as cranes & lifting, machine guarding, and energy isolation* Proficiency in EHS management systems (ISO 14001; ISO 45001) and skills in auditing and root cause investigation* Good written and spoken German and English skills, with a willingness to travel occasionallyAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #RPO

jobs.description: Create your own happiness!Are you a passionate early childhood educator (m/f/d)? Do you put your heart and soul into your work, but haven’t been satisfied with your working conditions so far?Come check us out—maybe you’ll like what you find here?What you can look forward to…The basics: pay, vacation time, and working hours.We are actually offering a fixed-term full-time position. The full-time workweek is 38 hours. Initially, the contract would be fixed-term, but an extension is possible.Pay is based on the TVöD SuE collective bargaining agreement and depends on your professional experience and qualifications. A 13th month’s salary (at 100%, instead of 85%) is paid after one year of service. We have between 32 and 34 days of vacation per year. Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve are paid holidays. In your daily work, you would speak mainly English.We would appreciate at least some experience in this field and a preference for this age group would be advantageous.Our working conditions are truly worth highlighting: In the elementary section, four colleagues together care for 35 children; in the nursery section, four additional colleagues care for 16 children. In addition, we employ a housekeeping staff member with educational qualifications and, in the future, a substitute.We hold weekly team meetings to discuss weekly schedules, activities, and specific situations, as well as to plan parent-teacher conferences and developmental meetings. Our sponsoring organization places great emphasis on providing good working conditions.The Team: One for all, all for one!Some of us have been working together successfully and happily for over ten years. It goes without saying that we support one another and treat each other with care. Our sense of humor and our willingness to stand up for one another carry us through the sometimes hectic daily routine of the daycare center.On concept days, we discuss educational topics, engage in professional development, and reflect on our work. Regular weekly team meetings, preparation time, and supervision are just as much a part of our routine as extended get-togethers during company outings and Christmas parties.Has this piqued your curiosity? Then you should definitely keep reading…Important: Empathy, joy, and qualifications.To ensure we comply with legal requirements, it is very important that our new team member holds a completed, state-recognized qualification as an early childhood educator (m/f/d), a degree in early childhood education or early childhood development, or a degree as a social pedagogue (m/f/d). It would be helpful if you have a good understanding of the English language, as we are a bilingual facility.We are looking for an empathetic person with a Reggio Emilia approach (including a child-centered perspective) and someone who genuinely enjoys working with children, because we want you to look forward to coming to work.Feel free to get to know us!The Daycare Center: Location. Concept. Focus Areas.The daycare center is located in the heart of Planten un Blomen and is surrounded by plenty of greenery. It is easily accessible by public transportation from all parts of Hamburg (Gänsemarkt, Dammtor, Stephansplatz).There are two groups, a nursery group and an elementary group, in which 42-48 children are currently cared for by nine early childhood educators. Our facilities allow us to organize various projects and activities in workshops and specialized rooms.The foundation of our concept is the Reggio approach. Above all, it reflects our attitude toward others and how we wish to approach life’s changes. Our daycare is a place for self-directed, holistic learning, and we foster a respectful approach not only toward the children entrusted to us, but toward all people.We integrate key areas such as yoga, woodworking, art studio work, language development, music, relaxation and movement, and preschool preparation into our daily routine. Do you have a particular focus? A passion? Let’s find out together if we can integrate this into our daily routine as well…Start up initiative: Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.Our small operator, “Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.”, was founded in 2008 and is a member of the Paritätischer Wohlfahrtsverband Hamburg. Loki Schmidt was the founding patron of our daycare center.Our organization consists of a single facility. This means that decisions can be made and implemented quickly, easily, and on an individual basis. Here, people are still allowed to be people; they are heard and are not just a personnel number.As a member of the Bucerius family and an initiative of the ZEIT STIFTUNG BUCERIUS, our work makes an important contribution to promoting an open, democratic society.The Future: Do you think we’re a good fit for you?Then please send us your application materials. We would love to get to know you.If you’re interested, feel free to check out our website (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita) ) or our Instagram account (kita.buceriuslaw).Thank you for your attention, and we hope to see you soon!
